name: Freedom Trail Walk
description: 2.5-mile marked historic walking path through downtown Boston past 16 Revolutionary War sites.

name: Museum of Fine Arts
description: Major art museum with strong American, European, and Asian collections.

name: Boston Harborwalk
description: Waterfront walking path along the harbor with skyline and seaport views (coastal).

name: New England Aquarium
description: Large downtown aquarium with penguin exhibit, giant ocean tank, and harbor seal shows.

name: Fenway Park Tour
description: Guided tour of the historic Red Sox ballpark, including the Green Monster.

name: Boston Common & Public Garden
description: Central parks for walking, people-watching, and (seasonally) Swan Boats in the Public Garden.
